title: Coherence of a qubit with T₂ = 100 μs
caption: Dephasing makes the off-diagonal (coherence) terms of the density matrix decay as e^{−t/T₂}. With T₂ = 100 μs and a gate time of 50 ns, T₂ lasts 2000 gate times: after 2000 gates only 1/e = 0.37 of the coherence is left, and after 500 gates it has already fallen to 0.78. Long algorithms therefore need error correction.
alt: Graph of coherence against the number of 50 nanosecond gates from 0 to 6000: an exponential decay passing 0.37 at 2000 gates.
description: The horizontal axis is the number of 50 ns gate operations (elapsed time ÷ 50 ns); the vertical axis is the remaining coherence, starting at 1.
The curve is e^{−t/T₂} = e^{−n/2000}, since T₂/50 ns = 2000.
At n = 2000 gates (t = T₂ = 100 μs) the coherence is 1/e = 0.37.
Beyond a few thousand gates little coherence remains.

checks.name: T₂ = 100 μs is 2000 gate times of 50 ns; coherence is 1/e there
